title.zh: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins
title.en: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins

current_state.zh: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum layer-2 network built on Arbitrum technology, launched on mainnet July 1, 2026, to support tokenized real-world assets and DeFi, with meme coins driving early activity and gas costs covered for Robinhood Wallet users until September 29.
